texts.utf8: 8x TANGENTIAL SLOTS 4 x 5, EQ. SP. 45° - CCW SWIRL
10x TANGENTIAL SLOTS 4 x 6, EQ. SP. 36° - CW SWIRL
Ø22 VENTURI ROOT O.D. AT x=10
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm. SHEET A3, SCALE 2:1. x = 0 AT FORWARD FACE, FLOW LEFT TO RIGHT.
2. COUNTER-ROTATING RADIAL-RADIAL SWIRL CUP: 8 PRIMARY PASSAGES (CCW), 10 SECONDARY PASSAGES (CW),
VENTURI AND FLARE; REFERENCE DIAMETER D0 = 27. CONFIGURATION AFTER WANG ET AL., J. FLUID MECH. 583 (2007).
3. ONLY THE PASSAGE COUNTS, SWIRL SENSES AND D0 ARE FROM THE PAPER. ALL OTHER DIMENSIONS ARE CHOSEN HERE.
THE PAPER'S ELLIPTICAL PRIMARY JETS ARE REPLACED BY STRAIGHT RECTANGULAR SLOTS (SKETCH + EXTRUDE-CUT).
4. SLOT CENTRELINE OFFSET FROM AXIS: PRIMARY 8, SECONDARY 11. FLOW AREAS: PRIMARY 160 mm2, SECONDARY 240 mm2
5. FUEL NOZZLE BORE Ø10. VENTURI: INLET Ø24, THROAT Ø14 x 2 LONG, EXIT Ø17, LIP Ø19 AT x = 21.
6. MODELLING: (a) REVOLVE HALF PROFILE 360°; (b) CUT 8 PRIMARY SLOTS x = 3..8; (c) CUT 10 SECONDARY SLOTS x = 10..16.
7. GENERIC RESEARCH GEOMETRY - NOT AN ENGINE PART DRAWING.
